# Writing a `task-flow` page

Generated from `task-flow`'s own template declarations. It states what this type requires;
the rules that apply to every page are in `wiki-authoring-spec.md` beside this file.

- **Lives at** module flow `product/flows/<module>/<kebab-task>.md`; shared flow `product/flows/_shared/<kebab-task>.md`, or `product/flows/<deliverable>/_shared/<kebab-task>.md` for a base only one deliverable's areas share
- **Authorship** `canonical` — human-authored only — no agent drafts this type for you
- **Freshness** stale after 90d
- **Template version** 1 — set `template-version: 1`

## Frontmatter

The type table demands no field beyond the base set.

The template also scaffolds `template-version`, `sources`, `related`, `origination`, `confidence` — fill or empty each one; leaving a placeholder is an error.

`owner:` is fixed to `product` — do not change it.

## Placeholders to replace

{{TITLE}} {{DATE}} {{CONFIDENCE}} {{ORIGINATION}}. Leaving one in place is an error (`unsubstituted-token`), and so is leaving a template example line (`template-example-line`).

The body also carries 7 placeholders written in angle brackets — `<action>`, `<actor action>`, `<behavior that must hold beyond the main path's end state>`, `<empty / loading / error>`, `<state transition or effect>`, `<system response>`, `<what is unresolved>`. Each stands for content you write; replace every one, including in a row whose other cells you have already filled. Leaving one is an error (`unsubstituted-placeholder`).

## Where this type may link

This page lives in `product/` (layer 1).

You may link to `domain/` — and to other pages in `product/`.

You may not link to `design/`, `engineering/`, `operations/`, `gtm/`, `governance/`. Those sub-wikis cite this one, never the other way round; when you need to name something there, name it in prose instead of linking it.

## Sections

Keep every heading, in this order: `## Task`, `## Preconditions`, `## Delta from the shared flow`, `## Steps`, `## Flow diagram`, `## Alternate & error paths`, `## Anytime actions`, `## Postcondition`, `## Acceptance criteria`, `## Delegated decisions`, `## Open questions`.

**This type must not carry** `## Boundaries` — that content has another home.

**Table columns you may not drop:**

- `## Open questions` — `Question` | `Owner` | `Resume condition`

**Structured cells:** each takes the form its grammar defines in `wiki-cell-grammars.md` §Cell grammars and the grammar files it names. A value in any other form is an error (`cell-grammar`).

- `Steps › (label)` — `step-marker`
- `Alternate & error paths › (label)` — `step-marker`
- `Anytime actions › (label)` — `step-marker`

## After you save

Two steps finish the page and neither is in the template:

- Commit the file under your own identity — authorship is a git fact, not a frontmatter one.
- Run `/wiki-reindex` so the page appears in its sub-wiki `index.md` and in `_derived/cited-by.md`. Until then it exists but nothing links to it.
